note: Ledger 4 command triage. Every entry is an ADMISSION: DEAD means the issuing module does not ship in the default production bundle; LIVE BREAK means bundled frontend code invokes an unregistered command; LEDGER DEFECT means the scanner reports a dynamic or type-only form it does not currently resolve.  A LIVE BREAK IS NOT AN EXCEPTION. Eight were listed here and removed by the conductor on 2026-08-03: an exception suppresses the violation entirely (lib/report.mjs:74), so accepting a live break turns this ledger GREEN over eight bundled modules invoking commands that do not exist. They stay RED until registered, deleted, or ruled out of scope. See DEFECTS.md D-137.
